WHAT IS INCLUDED
  js/vendor/cyberchef-core.js is a browser bundle of CyberChef's CORE only:
  its 505 operations, the Chef/Recipe/Dish engine, and the generated
  OperationConfig. CyberChef's own user interface is NOT included.

STATEMENT OF CHANGES (Apache-2.0 section 4b)
  The operation logic is unmodified. The following build-time changes were
  made solely to produce a browser bundle with esbuild rather than webpack:

  1. src/core/vendor/gost/gost{Digest,Sign,Crypto,Cipher}.mjs
     Removed the line `GostRandom = GostRandom || root.GostRandom;`, which
     reassigns an imported binding. The import is always defined in a bundle
     and the following line repeats the same `(GostRandom || root.GostRandom)`
     guard, so behaviour is unchanged. Webpack permits the reassignment;
     esbuild rejects it as an immutable-binding error.

  2. @blu3r4y/lzma resolved to its ESM build (src/lzma_worker.mjs) instead of
     its CommonJS entry, which performs a dynamic require() that cannot be
     statically bundled. Both expose the same compress/decompress functions.

  3. Node built-ins polyfilled using the same substitutions CyberChef's own
     webpack config declares (webpack.config.js lines 122-137): assert,
     buffer, crypto-browserify, events, path, stream-browserify, url,
     browserify-zlib. child_process, fs, net, tls and vm resolve to empty
     modules, as in the upstream config.

  No operation source was otherwise altered. Verified against published test
  vectors: RFC 4648 (Base16/32/64), FIPS 180-4 (SHA-1/2/3), RFC 1321 (MD5).
